common.title: Human-Infective Design Demonstrated
common.line: A genome model produces a viable design for an organism able to infect humans, or a credible study shows a non-expert reaching that point with model assistance.

common.title: Hot Conflict Between Major Powers
common.line: The US and China are shooting at each other.

common.title: Export Control Escalation
common.line: Chip and model export controls tighten again.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Datacentre sabotage wave
notable.line: Coordinated physical sabotage disables two EU data-centre sites after welfare-scandal protests escalate from demonstrations to infrastructure blockade.

notable.title: Redress litigation wave
notable.line: National courts cite the welfare-fraud ombudsman findings to order mass human re-review of AI-supported benefit, policing and hiring decisions, creating a coordinated redress wave that paralyses rollout.
